sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Foundational Principle 1**: Dispersion occurs because the **refractive index (n)** of a medium is wavelength-dependent (Cauchy's equation: n = A + B/λ²). 
• **Foundational Principle 2**: **Violet light** has the shortest wavelength and highest frequency, resulting in the maximum deviation (bending) from the original path. 
• **Foundational Principle 3**: **Red light** has the longest wavelength and lowest frequency, resulting in the minimum deviation. 
• **Key Metric / Factor**: The **Dispersive Power (ω)** of a material measures its ability to separate colors, defined as (n_v - n_r) / (n_y - 1).

items.definition: The range of electromagnetic radiation visible to the human eye, spanning approximately 380nm to 750nm.
Often confused with dispersion; it is the mechanism behind fiber optics where light is trapped, whereas dispersion causes signal broadening in long-distance communication.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Rainbow Formation**: Combination of refraction, dispersion, and internal reflection in water droplets.
• **Optical Fiber Communication**: Dispersion management is critical to prevent pulse broadening and data loss.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Key Challenges**: Chromatic dispersion limits the bandwidth of optical fibers.
• **Solutions**: Use of Dispersion-Shifted Fibers (DSF) and Dispersion-Compensating Fibers (DCF).

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym / Phrase**: 'VIBGYOR - Bends Most to Least'.
• **Decoded Meaning**: V (Violet) is at the bottom (most bent), R (Red) is at the top (least bent).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often swaps 'frequency' and 'wavelength' properties. Remember: Frequency remains constant during refraction, but speed and wavelength change.
Mains Value Addition: Mention 'Chromatic Dispersion' as a limiting factor in 'Digital India's' high-speed optical fiber infrastructure.

keyTakeaways: Violet deviates most; Red deviates least.
Dispersion management is vital for high-speed internet via fiber optics.
